xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Demand as per the order is paid by the Company and matter has been closed
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Company had filed an appeal before Tribunal for Financial Year 2010-11 for additions to income made by the Assessing Officer. Thereafter, Tribunal has passed a favourable order for some of the issues and remanded back the matter to Assessing Officer for multiple issues. Tax - INR 320516451. Interest - As applicable.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: After due assessment of remanded back matters and giving effect to Tribunal directions, the assessing officer (AO) has passed an order giving relief on majority of the disallowances. Post AO order, tax liability has been reduced to ~INR 1.28 Cr. plus applicable interest. The Company will pay the Demand and settle the matter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Company has filed objections before Dispute Resolution Panel against the draft order passed for AY 2022-23 under section 144C(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 wherein the tax officer has made additions to income on account of transfer pricing adjustment and bad debts. Tax impact - 37,25,42,623. Interest as applicable.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Dispute Resolution Panel has given the directions to the tax officer. Consequently, the tax officer has passed the final order basis the Dispute Resolution Panel directions. Company is in the process of filing an appeal before Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Principal Commissioner of Customs (Adjudication), New Customs House, Ballard Estate, Mumbai
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Chromatographs were imported with NIL duty. Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) alliged the import to be GAS Ananlysis Apparatus with 10% Duty. The Company has filed appeal filed before the CESTAT (Mumbai) against the adjudication order. Amount involved in litigation is Rs.14,564,636 and interest as applicable and Redemption Fine is Rs. 28,650,000, Penalty on Company is Rs. 26,564,636 and applicable interest if any Penalty on 2 officails is Rs. 7,00,000/- each. The hearing before the CESTAT is yet to be held.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Department has filed miscellaneous applications for a change in name/cause title from “Principal Commissioner of Customs (Adjudication)” to “Principal Commissioner/Commissioner of Customs (Import), Mumbai Zone-III” to implead the jurisdiction with the highest revenue implication. The miscellaneous applications were listed on 12.11.2025. The Hon'ble Tribunal directed the Company and the individuals to substitute the petitions of the Department. The next date of hearing is on 12.01.2026.
